name: Norikawa Minami
source:
She is Kouta’s stepsister, and they grew up together from a young age.
Although they were separated when her brother moved to Tokyo, she moved there herself to attend college and they were reunited.
She harbors feelings for Kouta that go beyond those of siblings and hopes they can be together.
Of course, she has never dated anyone else.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01002344.html/]dlsite[/url]]
